products.name: Pre-Logon VPN for Cloud & Hybrid-Joined Devices — First-Time Off-Network Sign-In & Password Reset — Commercial
products.short_description: The decision + scenario guide for pre-logon VPN: how a brand-new remote user with no cached credentials completes their first Windows sign-in off-network, and how an expired password gets changed at the lock screen when the change must reach a domain controller. Choose device tunnel vs. SBL/PLAP, validate both scenarios, and stop over-deploying to cloud-only devices. Complements the two deployment products.
products.description:
Your new hire's laptop is at their house, off the network, with no cached credentials — how do they sign in?

Two everyday remote-work moments break when the network isn't up at Windows sign-in: a brand-new user with no cached credentials can't complete their first logon off-network, and a user whose password expired off-network can't change it because the change has to reach a domain controller. Pre-logon VPN fixes both by bringing the network up before or at sign-in. This solution is the decision, scenario, and validation layer that tells you which approach to use, how the two scenarios actually behave by device join type, and how to prove they work — it sits above the two pre-logon deployment products and complements them.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant to make this call. The package hands you the field-tested decision method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell that reports your fleet's join types and pre-logon readiness.

  • Simpler — a clear device-tunnel-vs-SBL/PLAP decision matrix by join type, OS SKU, VPN vendor, and support model; every object named and reused through validation and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open consulting meter; reusable on every rollout and every new-hire wave.
  • Tested — a scenario-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates for first-logon and password-reset.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the two problems, the two approaches (Always On VPN device tunnel vs. Cisco Secure Client Start Before Logon / PLAP), the decision matrix, and why join type is the whole story.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (a chosen/deployed approach or the companion product, segmentation groups, join-type inventory, DC reachability, machine cert + SKU for device tunnel, optional SSPR, break-glass) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.
  • Implementation Guide — run readiness, choose the approach via the decision matrix, segment the pilot, confirm the chosen companion object, then validate the two scenarios end to end — Gates A–E framed around scenario validation.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — fleet join-type + readiness discovery, on-device validation (join type, pre-logon path, DC reachability), a readiness coverage report, safe remediation (segmentation only), and a group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates (first-logon; off-network password change; Entra-joined confusion; DC reachability), plus field-proven Best Practices.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each decision feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next new-hire wave and the next project.

The bottom line

New hires sign in from anywhere on day one, expired passwords self-resolve off-network, and cloud-only devices don't get a tunnel they never needed — the right pre-logon approach, chosen once and proven.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, decision + implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview and only adjusts group membership — it creates no VPN profiles):
    • PREVPN-Discovery.ps1 — pre-logon VPN readiness discovery: fleet join types + pre-logon capability
    • PREVPN-Remediation.ps1 — safely add in-scope devices/users lacking a pre-logon path to the pilot group
    • PREVPN-Report.ps1 — fleet pre-logon readiness roll-up: join types + pre-logon path coverage
    • PREVPN-Set-ScopeTargeting.ps1 — create/populate the pilot (and production) segmentation group(s)
    • PREVPN-Validation.ps1 — confirm THIS device has a working pre-logon path to a domain controller

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
